Vendored source package: pcap-analyzer

Upstream repository: https://github.com/sandbornm/my-claude-skills
Upstream path: pcap-analyzer/
Vendored commit: ee55c354b064a356bf6d9b2965b48f683daef0b0
Vendored on: 2026-06-07
Upstream author metadata: sandbornm
Upstream package version: 1.0.0

No LICENSE file was present in the upstream repository at the vendored
commit. Treat these files as third-party source. Do not rewrite them to
match Cortex style unless Cortex intentionally forks the package and adds
clear local maintenance ownership.

Included files:

- scripts/pcap-analyze.sh
- scripts/analysis_scripts/*.py

The upstream Claude plugin manifest and upstream SKILL.md are not
vendored. Cortex keeps `skills/forensics/pcap/SKILL.md` as the only
active skill instruction file and carries only the reusable analyzer
scripts from the upstream package.

Runtime notes:

- The wrapper expects a POSIX shell, Python 3.8+, and the Python package
  scapy.
- tshark is optional but recommended by the upstream package.
- The scripts analyze local pcap/pcapng files and write outputs under an
  explicit output directory.
